C1.原句: The corresponding slurry was cast onto a carbon-coated aluminum (Al) foil and dried at 60 °C for 4 hours and further dried at 80 °C for 12 hours under vacuum, the S load is approximately 1.2mg cm-2.

指标.原句: Consequently, Li-S cells demonstrate markedly improved capacity retention from 50.9% to 75.7% over 200 cycles.
Furthermore, the LiFPB-containing electrolyte achieved a higher average coulombic eﬃ- ciency of 99.01%, compared to 97.62% in the conventional elec- trolyte.
The cell with the LiFPB-containing electrolyte exhibited a capacity retention of 75.7% (758.5 mAh g-1/ 1001.8 mAh g-1) after 200 cycles, Adv.
where the LiFPB-containing electrolyte demonstrated a capacity retention of 73.6%, notably outperform- ing the 56.41% retention of the conventional electrolyte.
The av- erage coulombic eﬃciency was also enhanced, increasing from 97.88% for the conventional electrolyte to 98.77% for the LiFPB- containing electrolyte.

In contrast, the battery with the conven- tional electrolyte retained only 530.6 mAh g-1 after 100 cycles, with an average coulombic eﬃciency of 96.71%, which is sig- nificantly lower than that achieved with the LiFPB-containing electrolyte.
The battery utilizing LiFPB-containing electrolyte exhibited an ini- tial specific capacity of 824.6 mAh g-1 (Figure 5g).
Aurbach’s measurement protocol showed that the Li||Cu cell with LiFPB-containing electrolyte achieved a CE of 99.59%, significantly outperforming the conventional elec- trolyte (97.73%) (Figure 2f).
